references.text: The same command not to turn aside to the right or to the left from what the Lord has commanded, given in the context of following the decisions of the judges.
The king shall not turn aside from the commandment, either to the right or to the left, so that he may live long in his kingdom.
The warning not to turn aside to the right or to the left from the Lord's commands, linked with the blessings and curses.
Joshua receives the same command to be strong and not to turn aside to the right or to the left from the law.
Joshua's exhortation to the people to hold fast to the law of Moses and not to turn aside from it to the right or to the left.
Wisdom about not turning aside to the right or to the left, but keeping one's foot away from evil.
The prophecy that the people will hear a voice saying which way they should go, whether they turn aside to the right or to the left.
Israel promises to walk on the main road and not to turn aside to the right or to the left when passing through Edom's land.
